sources.title: Data Sources
sources.description: Which sources to scrape. Options: linkedin_jobs, nppes, state_registries, niche_directories, asa_members, fdd_franchisees, sam_gov. Leave empty to run all.

testMode.title: Test Mode
testMode.description: Limit each scraper to a small sample. Use to verify the actor works before a full run.

linkedinQueries.title: LinkedIn Job Search Queries
linkedinQueries.description: Keywords to search on LinkedIn Jobs. Agency-specific formats only — travel assignments and locum tenens.

linkedinLocations.title: LinkedIn Search Locations (Cities)
linkedinLocations.description: City/metro areas to search separately on LinkedIn. Each query runs once per location, surfacing boutique local agencies. Leave empty for a single national search.

linkedinTimeFilter.title: LinkedIn Posting Recency
linkedinTimeFilter.description: Only return companies that posted jobs within this window. Options: day, 3days, week, month, 2months.

nppsQueries.title: NPPES Organization Name Queries
nppsQueries.description: Wildcard searches on organization_name in the CMS NPI registry. Use * for contains (e.g. *staffing*).

states.title: State Registries to Scrape
states.description: Which state government registries to include. Options: NY, IN, TN, MD, MN, NJ, TX, PA, NC, WA, MI, FL.

nicheDirectorySources.title: Niche Directory Sources
nicheDirectorySources.description: Which travel nurse / niche directories to scrape. Options: natho, vivian.

samGovApiKey.title: SAM.gov API Key
samGovApiKey.description: Free API key from sam.gov (Account Details → Public API Key). Required to use the sam_gov source.

samGovMaxRecords.title: SAM.gov Max Records
samGovMaxRecords.description: Maximum number of entities to pull from SAM.gov.
